chunks: On the Day of Resurrection they will carry their own burden and some of the load of those they have led astray without any knowledge. Oh, how evil a burden they will carry!
ai.seo_question: What burden do those who mislead others carry on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cumulative weight of misguidance, where leaders bear their own sins plus the sins of those they misled without knowledge, emphasizing the gravity of intellectual and spiritual authority. The phrase 'without knowledge' (bi-ghayr 'ilm) is often interpreted to include both ignorance and deliberate distortion, making it a key text for evaluating scholars and imams. This shared burden underscores the profound responsibility of those who guide the community, linking individual accountability to collective spiritual fate.
